text: Cycling is an excellent form of exercise that offers a low-impact workout while providing a fun and environmentally friendly way to travel. The primary function of a bicycle is to propel a rider forward by turning the pedals, which ultimately powers the wheels. To slow down or stop, a cyclist needs to engage the brakes. These brakes are typically achieved by pulling on either the front or rear brake levers. The tires of a bicycle are critical components that provide traction and stability. They are designed to absorb the impact of the road and ensure a smooth ride, even over varied terrain. Proper tire pressure and regular maintenance are essential for maintaining the longevity and safety of the tires.
